```python
"""One-time cleanup for LIFE-203: merge duplicate households in the registry.

This script MODIFIES data/registry.json. Run it once from the Lifeline root:

    python scripts/merge_duplicates.py

For each group of active records that are really the same family (same Soundex
name key and head's birth year, see registry.dedup), the record with a valid
household ID is kept and every other record in the group is marked status
'merged' with merged_into pointing at the kept record. No record is deleted
and no other field is changed.
"""

import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from core.ids import is_valid_household_id
from registry.dedup import find_duplicates
from registry.register import load_households, save_households, set_status


def main() -> None:
    households = load_households()
    by_id = {h.id: h for h in households}
    groups = find_duplicates(households)
    if not groups:
        print("No duplicate families found; nothing to do.")
        return

    for group in groups:
        kept_id = next((hid for hid in group if is_valid_household_id(hid)), group[0])
        kept = by_id[kept_id]
        print(f"Family {kept.head.name} (head born {kept.head.birth_date[:4]}):")
        print(f"  keeping {kept.id}"
              + ("" if is_valid_household_id(kept.id) else "  WARNING: no valid ID in group"))
        for other_id in group:
            if other_id == kept_id:
                continue
            other = by_id[other_id]
            set_status(other_id, "merged", merged_into=kept_id)
            other.status = "merged"
            other.merged_into = kept_id
            print(f"  merged {other_id} into {kept_id}")

    save_households(households)
    print(f"Merged {sum(len(g) - 1 for g in groups)} duplicate record(s) "
          f"in {len(groups)} group(s).")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
